stories.title: Russia, China to work out permanent visa-free regime — Kremlin
stories.summary: The issue will be worked out and coordinated by the two sides, Kremlin Spokesman Dmitry Peskov said
article_sentences: Russia and China will work out and coordinate the issue of making the visa-free regime between the two countries permanent, Kremlin Spokesman Dmitry Peskov told TASS.

"The issue will be worked out and coordinated by the two sides," the Kremlin spokesman said in response to a question about whether Chinese President Xi Jinping had supported Russian President Vladimir Putin’s proposal to make the visa-free regime between Russia and China permanent.

At a meeting with Xi Jinping in Bishkek on August 31, Putin said Russia was ready to work jointly with China on making the visa-free regime between the two countries permanent if Beijing considered such a step possible and beneficial.
